description: Chain-tier verdict meta-vectors: (actual, entry) -> grade_chain verdict. A comparator implementation is conformant iff it reproduces every `verdict`. Encodes the chain-tier grading from grade_chain (contract §4): value-only tier — single `value` dimension; panicked and not-implemented reuse the shared vocabulary. Precedence: panicked → coal unconditionally; not-implemented → coverage; then value grading by kind. retargeting: exact nbits match; voting: parameters deep-equal AND activated_update string-equal. errored where a value is expected is coal. Unknown kind is coal — never a silent pass. On voting reject vectors (expected.error == 'errored') errored is the graded nice outcome; panicked still precedes everything.

cases.name: retargeting-nice
cases.description: Retargeting: actual nbits matches expected nbits, error null → value nice.

cases.name: retargeting-errored-coal
cases.description: Retargeting: error:errored where a value is expected → coal. v1 corpus is accept-shaped so errored is always red.

cases.name: voting-nice
cases.description: Voting: parameters deep-equal AND activated_update string-equal → value nice.

cases.name: voting-table-coal
cases.description: Voting: parameters mismatch (one value differs) → value coal.

cases.name: voting-update-coal
cases.description: Voting: table matches but activated_update differs (non-empty vs empty) → value coal. Graded by string equality: '0000' ≠ '02d701990300'.

cases.name: panicked
cases.description: Panicked actual: coal unconditionally before any expected check.

cases.name: unknown-kind-coal
cases.description: Unknown kind in a graded run is coal — never a silent pass (contract §4).

cases.name: voting-reject-errored-nice
cases.description: Voting reject vector (expected.error errored): the runner's errored envelope is the graded NICE outcome (JVM throw parity, contract §2 reject form).

cases.name: voting-reject-value-coal
cases.description: Voting reject vector: a produced value where the JVM throws is coal.

cases.name: voting-reject-panicked-coal
cases.description: Voting reject vector: panicked precedes the reject check — throw parity means catching + classifying, never crashing.

cases.name: voting-reject-not-implemented-coverage
cases.description: Voting reject vector: not-implemented still grades coverage (the growth-ledger stance holds on reject vectors).
